convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iMA indicators (iMA is standard MT5). Simple MA crossover entry/exit with fixed SL/TP. No external .mqh libraries. No custom indicators. Straightforward position sizing and risk controls.

derived_values.name: Digit-adjusted Point value
derived_values.used_by: Stop Loss and Take Profit pip calculation

other_exits: Signal reversal closes opposite position before opening new one - PositionsTotal()==0 check means existing opposite side is closed via signal reversal before new entry

position_sizing.conditional_logic: When Lots input is negative, uses fixed lot size (abs value). When Lots input is positive, calculates lot size as fraction of free margin: (FreeMargin * Lots/100) / (SL_pips * TickValue), subject to LotStep and min/max constraints.

custom_logic_notes: The EA uses dynamic averaging via two SMAs where the slow period is double the fast period (Periods*2). Entry signals are evaluated on the previous completed bar (shift [1]) to avoid repainting. The digit adjustment logic multiplies SL/TP by 10 when _Digits is 3 or 5, normalizing pip values across 4/5-digit brokers. Conditional lot sizing: negative Lots = fixed lots, positive Lots = risk percentage of free margin calculated against stop loss distance.
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward MA crossover strategy. Use pandas TA or talib for SMA calculations. Digit adjustment must be replicated: if price has 3 or 5 decimal places, multiply SL/TP by 10 to convert to points. Conditional lot sizing logic: if lots<0 use abs(lots) as fixed; if lots>0 compute as (free_margin * lots/100) / (SL_distance * tick_value). New bar detection needed to prevent multiple signals per bar. Signal evaluated on previous completed bar (shift=1). Close opposite position on signal reversal before opening new one.
